title: Procedure Development for Identification of Histamine from Chicken Meat
protocol: Add ten grams of chicken meat sample dried powder to 150 mL methyl alcohol in a pyrex flask.
Place the flask containing the sample and methyl alcohol in an oven at 70°C for 7 minutes.
Remove the flask from the oven and place it on a hot plate magnetic stirrer.
Stir the mixture rapidly (1600 RPM) at 80°C for 8 minutes.
Filter the stirred sample using Whatman No.1 filter paper.
Spot 0.5 μl of the filter extract on a TLC plate along with standard histamine (0.5 μl).
Prepare a 2% ninhydrin solution in acetone.
Dry the TLC plate in air.
Spray the dried TLC plate with ninhydrin.
Air dry the TLC plate sprayed with ninhydrin.
Visualize the TLC plate using Spectroline (UV long wave) and photograph it.
